rows.description: All your computers and your phone, working as one desk. Screens, apps, files, clipboard, calls, texts, notifications, mouse and keyboard, shared between Mac, Windows, Linux and Android. Free and open source. No account, no cloud, and now no shared network needed.
Any window from your Mac, live on your iPhone or iPad. Touch, Apple Pencil, trackpad and keys. Free, open source, no servers.
Free, open-source screen sharing for private live streams with friends. Watch together in a browser or self-host Piik. 免费开源的私密屏幕共享，支持游戏直播、一起看电影与自部署。
Lightweight, self-hosted, open-source chat server with voice, video, text, and screen sharing. Built for small groups who want privacy, simplicity, and full control over their data.

🏆 Self-hosted, open-source WebRTC video conferencing platform for real-time communication and collaboration. A modern alternative to Zoom, Google Meet, Jitsi Meet, and Microsoft Teams, powered by scalable SFU architecture with Mediasoup.
Share your screen with one simple room code. No downloads or sign-ups required.
